prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production RGBA sprite atlas for a layered paper popup battle terrarium, 1536x1024 landscape. This is an atlas of separate cutout pieces, NOT a complete diorama or ball.
Primary request: highly detailed, beautifully crafted flat cut-paper scenery for Pokémon Emerald's Meteor Falls: warm ochre limestone, dark blue cave depth, cool turquoise falls, sparse moss and fern. Each object is a visibly THIN layered cardstock silhouette with cream cut edges, torn/creased paper fibres, smaller overlapping surface patches and fine drawn cracks. Storybook paper theatre, flat frontal artwork, subtle contact shadows ONLY between attached paper laminations. No bulky 3D miniature, no photoreal stone, no voxel blocks, no bevelled polygon piles.
Composition: EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows of separate isolated assets, all within their cell with at least 18px transparent padding. No grid lines or text. All unoccupied pixels fully transparent, including openings inside arches. Left to right:
TOP ROW (each ~360x310):
1. Tall irregular LEFT limestone cliff card, terraced silhouette and layered strata, tiny fern growing from cracks, warm honey/ochre/cream paper.
2. Tall irregular RIGHT limestone cliff card, several flat zigzag stair steps across front, tiny dark opening, matching stone strata, sparse moss.
3. A thin open cave rim made of overlapping angular ochre paper strips, asymmetrical broken silhouette, a LARGE genuinely transparent central opening, no scene/background inside hole, uneven roof teeth, not a perfect arch.
4. Distant deep navy/teal cave strata silhouette, many overlapping pointed thin paper ridges, uneven top and bottom, dark but distinguishable layers.
MIDDLE ROW:
5. Broad shallow turquoise pool/ripple strip, four staggered overlapping blue paper wave ribbons and cream froth scallops, frontal slightly top-down, no rocks or surrounding ground.
6. One tall narrow vertical waterfall ribbon made of parallel sky-blue and turquoise paper strips, pale vertical highlights, white foam scallops at bottom, no rocks or landscape behind it.
7. Hanging cluster of 5 uneven sharp ochre stalactite PAPER triangles, overlapping mineral bands and thin cream cut edges, open gaps between spikes, no bulky horizontal slab.
8. Detailed sparse fern/moss cluster of individual flat serrated olive/emerald paper fronds, fine veins and multiple layers, no flowerpot.
BOTTOM ROW:
9. Low wide flat-topped ochre limestone trainer podium, readable pale dry top and layered front paper strata, short narrow footprint, minimal slightly top down view.
10. Small dark slate meteorite fragment as several overlapping thin charcoal paper polygons with subtle blue mineral veins, surrounded by two tiny loose fragments, no glow cloud.
11. A single elongated turquoise water drop with one pale inset paper highlight, large in its cell, no splash and no backdrop.
12. A low foreground cluster of ochre paper scree, tiny cream mineral shards and sparse moss, many small overlapping cut-paper details, irregular silhouette.
Lighting: warm restrained upper-left diffuse light, no global shadows, no reflections. Rich crafted detail even at small game size. Consistent scale of paper grain across entire atlas.
Constraints: EXACT twelve separate pieces. Transparent RGBA background. No ball, characters, labels, frame, checkerboard, ground plane, strings (strings added by runtime), watermarks, complete scenic panels, or blurred backdrop. All silhouettes fully contained, no cut-off tips. Preserve clear cut-paper appearance over volume.
